title: 信息日报 2026-11-02

headline.title: 加拿大与欧盟宣布成立开放联盟，欢迎志同道合国家加入
headline.summary: 加拿大与欧盟在蒙特利尔峰会上宣布成立“未来联盟”，称其将为民众提供保护，并对冲地缘政治的不确定性，同时向其他志同道合国家开放。
headline.title_en: Canada and EU announce new alliance open to like-minded countries
headline.summary_en: Canada and the EU unveiled the Alliance for the Future at a Montreal summit, describing it as a protective canopy for citizens and a hedge against geopolitical uncertainty, open to like-minded countries.
headline.original_title: Canada and EU announce new alliance open to like-minded countries
headline.reason: 报道具体说明加拿大与欧盟在蒙特利尔宣布新联盟及其开放性质，属于地缘政治与外交结盟的重要动向。
headline.reason_en: The report specifies the Canada-EU alliance announced in Montreal and its open membership, a significant geopolitical and diplomatic alignment.
